item.title: Chinese suspects in Dubai abductions arrested in Bangkok
item.description: Two Chinese men have been arrested at luxury condominiums in Bangkok in connection with the abduction and detention of three people who were found dead in Dubai in June.

item.title: Thailand races to protect data after PHP alert
item.description: Thai authorities have urged organisations to urgently update websites and systems using PHP to prevent potential personal data leaks, with universities and medical school hospitals told to prioritise patient records and student databases.

item.title: Heat turned down on holy basil controversy
item.description: Thailand’s agriculture minister has stepped in to calm the nerves of farmers and foodies about access to holy basil for the country’s beloved phat kaphrao stir-fry.
